primary_interface: BIOMERO workflow for OMERO and Slurm
measurement_basis: Unnormalized working pyramid overview. Per-axis geometry scales to native pixels; area, valid counts and total intensity multiply by sy*sx. Means/min/max retain overview values. Native smooth raster area can differ slightly.
limitations: The 47 GB profile has not been tested on actual Helios hardware.
Full native-pixel and every-table-cell roundtrip comparisons were not completed.
Anatomical-layer proposals overlapped broadly; successful execution is not biological validation.
The tested BIOMERO deployment reported incomplete storage-provenance annotations; image import and independently checked CSV values succeeded.
Host/GPU memory depends on view shape, prompt and object count; measured values are not guaranteed maxima.
